name: tovu
description: Tovu — the website product: CMS runtime (public site + per-site admin + content model).

scripts.dev: TOVU_ADMIN_DEV_PROXY_URL=http://localhost:5173 npm run dev:server & npm run admin:dev & wait
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/templates && cp -R templates/. dist/templates/ && mkdir -p dist/themes && cp -R themes/. dist/themes/ && mkdir -p dist/src/infra/drizzle && cp -R src/infra/drizzle/. dist/src/infra/drizzle/ && mkdir -p dist/src/infra/drizzle-database-journal && cp -R src/infra/drizzle-database-journal/. dist/src/infra/drizzle-database-journal/ && mkdir -p dist/public && cp -R public/. dist/public/
scripts.test:cov: rm -rf coverage && mkdir -p coverage && node --import tsx --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout "src/**/*.test.ts" "packages/*/src/**/*.test.ts"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run admin:install && npm run admin:build
